environment.description: Application deployed on an EC2 instance behind a classic ELB (TCP passthrough mode) in a public subnet. The ELB forwards raw TCP on port 443 to the instance on port 8080. Security group allows inbound 443 from 0.0.0.0/0. No additional request inspection layer. The application is served directly by Flask's built-in WSGI server with gunicorn in front (gunicorn --bind 0.0.0.0:8080 app:app). SQLite database at /var/data/users.db contains production user records including admin accounts with api_keys.
